note.title: subdomain discovery
note.intro: enumeracao de subdominios e crucial pra expandir a superficie de ataque. dominios esquecidos, ambientes de dev/staging, e portais internos expostos sao os alvos mais faceis.
commands:
# browser: https://crt.sh/?q=%25.alvo.com
# via curl com jq
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.alvo.com&output=json" | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sed 's/\*\.//g' | sort -u > crtsh_subs.txt

# via certspotter
curl -s "https://api.certspotter.com/v1/issuances?domain=alvo.com&include_subdomains=true&expand=dns_names" | jq -r '.[].dns_names[]' | sort -u

# subfinder (suporta +30 fontes passivas)
subfinder -d alvo.com -all -o subfinder.txt
subfinder -dL domains.txt -all -o all_subs.txt

# amass (owasp, modulo passivo)
amass enum -passive -d alvo.com -o amass.txt

# assetfinder (rapidao, unica fonte)
assetfinder --subs-only alvo.com | tee assetfinder.txt

# github + google dorks (subdominios em repositorios)
github-subdomains -d alvo.com -t $GITHUB_TOKEN

# securitytrails
curl -s "https://api.securitytrails.com/v1/domain/alvo.com/subdomains?children_only=false" \
  -H "APIKEY: TOKEN" | jq -r '.subdomains[]' | sed 's/$/.alvo.com/'

# alienvault otx
curl -s "https://otx.alienvault.com/api/v1/indicators/domain/alvo.com/passive_dns" | \
  jq -r '.passive_dns[].hostname' | sort -u

# rapiddns
curl -s "https://rapiddns.io/subdomain/alvo.com?full=1" | grep -oP 'title="\K[^"]+' | grep "alvo.com" | sort -u

# gobuster dns
gobuster dns -d alvo.com -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/DNS/subdomains-top1million-5000.txt -t 100 -o gobuster_dns.txt

# puredns (resolve + bruteforce com massdns)
puredns bruteforce /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/DNS/subdomains-top1million-5000.txt alvo.com -r resolvers.txt -w puredns.txt

# shuffledns (wrapper do massdns)
shuffledns -d alvo.com -w wordlist.txt -r resolvers.txt -o shuffledns.txt

# dnsgen + massdns (permutacoes)
dnsgen subs_conhecidos.txt | shuffledns -d alvo.com -r resolvers.txt -o dnsgen_new.txt

# alterx (permutacoes inteligentes)
alterx -l subs_conhecidos.txt -enrich -o permutations.txt
puredns resolve permutations.txt -r resolvers.txt -w resolved.txt

# httpx (multi-funcao, o melhor)
cat all_subs.txt | httpx -silent -status-code -title -tech-detect -follow-redirects -o httpx_results.txt

# so ips vivos
cat all_subs.txt | httpx -silent -o live_subs.txt

# filtrando por status code
cat all_subs.txt | httpx -silent -mc 200,301,302,403 -o interesting.txt

# httpx com screenshot preview
cat live_subs.txt | httpx -silent -screenshot -screenshot-dir screens/

# alternativa: httprobe (mais simples)
cat all_subs.txt | httprobe -c 50 | tee live_subs.txt
subfinder -d alvo.com -all -silent | dnsgen - | puredns resolve -r resolvers.txt | httpx -silent -status-code -title -o full_recon.txt

# subjack
subjack -w subs.txt -t 100 -timeout 30 -ssl -c fingerprints.json -o takeover.txt

# nuclei takeover templates
nuclei -l live_subs.txt -t ~/nuclei-templates/takeovers/ -o takeover_nuclei.txt

# verificar cnames suspeitos manualmente
dig CNAME sub.alvo.com +short | grep -E "amazonaws.com|azure|github.io|herokuapp|surge.sh|netlify"

#!/bin/bash
DOMAIN=$1
OUTDIR="recon/$DOMAIN"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

echo "[*] passivo..."
subfinder -d "$DOMAIN" -all -silent > "$OUTDIR/passive.txt"
assetfinder --subs-only "$DOMAIN" >> "$OUTDIR/passive.txt"
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.$DOMAIN&output=json" | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sed 's/\*\.//g' >> "$OUTDIR/passive.txt"
sort -u "$OUTDIR/passive.txt" -o "$OUTDIR/passive.txt"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/passive.txt") subs passivos"

echo "[*] bruteforce..."
puredns bruteforce /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/DNS/subdomains-top1million-5000.txt "$DOMAIN" -r resolvers.txt > "$OUTDIR/bruteforce.txt"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/bruteforce.txt") subs bruteforce"

echo "[*] juntando..."
cat "$OUTDIR/passive.txt" "$OUTDIR/bruteforce.txt" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/all_subs.txt"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/all_subs.txt") subs unicos"

echo "[*] validando (httpx)..."
httpx -l "$OUTDIR/all_subs.txt" -silent -status-code -title -o "$OUTDIR/live.txt"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/live.txt") vivos"

echo "[*] takeover check..."
subjack -w "$OUTDIR/all_subs.txt" -t 100 -ssl -o "$OUTDIR/takeover.txt" 2>/dev/null

echo "[done] resultados em $OUTDIR/"

# tool dedicada
github-subdomains -d alvo.com -t $GITHUB_TOKEN -o gh_subs.txt

# google dork
# site:github.com "alvo.com"
# site:github.com "dev.alvo.com" -site:github.com/alvo

diff old_subs.txt new_subs.txt | grep "^>" | sed 's/^> //' > new_only.txt
# ou comm
comm -13 <(sort old_subs.txt) <(sort new_subs.txt) > new_only.txt
